# New World Solutions Co., Ltd.

> บริษัท นิว เวิลด์ โซลูชั่นส์ จำกัด (NEW WORLD SOLUTIONS CO., LTD.) provides building and construction materials, manufacturing technology equipment, and software services for businesses in Thailand.

- Canonical website: https://nwsthai.com/
- Legal entity ID (Thailand): 0135569018076
- Location: Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani, Thailand
- Services: building and construction materials; manufacturing technology; software services
- Primary language: Thai; supporting language: English
